messages:
sam: quick FYI while testing the runtime quickstart example: the curl's Referer header points at an internal design doc and returns 403 on staging (https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#auth). :grimacing:
leah: thanks — which exact URL? i can do a 1-line PR.
sam: the sample uses `https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth` in the Referer header. block is in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md`. snippet:
```
curl -X POST 'https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/generate' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' 
  -H 'Referer: https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth' 
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
mike: can we just replace the referer with an internal KB path under docs? shorter to rehost a minimal caveat than to change product links.
sam: rehosting preferred — keep it minimal to avoid i18n overhead (this file is included in ja).
doc-scan-bot: Link scanner: 1 broken external link found in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` -> https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth. Flagged 2026-03-21T14:02:12Z.
leah: i'll add a tiny `docs/kb/api-auth.md` with a short caveat and update the Referer in both `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` and `docs/examples/websocket-auth.md` in one PR. commit msg: "docs(kb): add api-auth note; docs: replace internal referer".
mike: please add a one-line changelog note and ping #i18n after merge so localization knows it's docs-only.
sam: sounds good. leah — assign to me for quick staging verification once merged.
leah: will open PR in ~30m and ping here. :thumbsup:
